name: SIGINT
standfirst: Security research and practitioner news, scored for novelty and actionability.
colophon: sigint.wtf — the correct response to most of these CVEs. Scored by machine against a hand-written rubric; ranking is opinion, not fact.

items.title: Ruby 4.0 Universal RCE Deserialization Gadget Chain
items.dek: Universal Ruby deserialization gadget chain enables RCE; requires immediate review if Ruby is in the SDLC dependency tree.
items.unproven: depends on whether reader's codebase uses vulnerable deserialization patterns; exploitation conditions not yet confirmed in production environments

items.title: Finding Vulnerabilities via LLM-Augmented Semantics-Aware Type-Checking
items.dek: LLM-based type checker detects 87% of Python web vulnerabilities by inferring semantic intent from variable names.
items.unproven: evaluation limited to web applications; no comparison against conventional SAST tools on same codebase; zero-day confirmation lacks disclosure details.

items.title: Trust Without Boundaries: An Architectural Analysis of Satellite Flight Software
items.dek: NASA Core Flight Software lacks internal trust boundaries; single compromised component exploits shared authority across onboard systems.
items.unproven: findings specific to cFS and NOS3 simulator; applicability to reader's financial services SDLC is indirect.

items.title: Lower Bounds on Black-Box Constructions of Pseudorandom Functions
items.dek: Proof that black-box PRF construction from PRG requires Ω(n/log n) non-adaptive calls; closes gap in GGM construction optimality.
items.unproven: theoretical result; no bearing on applied cryptography or the reader's tooling and process decisions.

items.title: A Fixed Universal Determinant is Variationally Complete for Continuum Fermions
items.dek: Two fixed universal Slater determinants suffice variationally for fermionic systems up to three dimensions, independent of particle count.
items.unproven: extension to higher dimensions; practical applicability to systems where determinant structure is unknown a priori.

items.title: To $\mathcal{PT}$ or not to $\mathcal{PT}$: Noise-induced escape and nonlinear-damping stabilization in a parity-time dimer
items.authors: Richelle Jade L. Tuquero et al.
items.dek: Duffing nonlinearity destabilizes parity-time-symmetric systems transiently; nonlinear damping restores global stochastic stability.
items.unproven: experimental demonstration in realistic PT systems; generalization to resonator types beyond those modeled.

items.title: STINER: Automated Extraction of Strategic Cyber Threat Intelligence from X
items.dek: STINER corpus and NER model extract threat actors and sectors from X with 8-entity taxonomy; benchmarks nine configurations on 2,100 alerts.
items.unproven: single source (X); no production deployment; threat intelligence feed integration not addressed; no comparison to vendor CTI parsers.

items.title: Equivalence Between Average-Case Hardness of Learning and Cryptography for Mixed Quantum States
items.dek: Equivalence proof between average-case learning hardness and one-way state generators for mixed quantum states.
items.unproven: theoretical cryptography; unrelated to reader's secure-SDLC, SAST/DAST, or post-quantum migration planning.

items.title: MazeRunner: Nonlinear Task and Clue Orchestration for LLM-driven Black-Box Automated Penetration Testing
items.dek: MazeRunner multi-agent LLM system conducts black-box penetration testing via nonlinear task orchestration; tested on 10 HTB targets.
items.unproven: evaluation on capture-the-flag exercises, not production systems; no evidence of applicability to reader's SDLC; token budget constraints not realistic for enterprise scope.

items.title: For the love of god stop using CPU limits in Kubernetes
items.dek: Kubernetes CPU limits often misconfig and harm stability; informs platform hardening this quarter if reader runs K8s.
items.unproven: scoped to CPU limits only; does not cover memory, I/O, or network resource controls

items.title: P2Skill: Privacy Preserving Skill Distillation for Cloud-Local LLM Inference Systems
items.dek: Prompt-based skill distillation routes PII-sensitive queries to local models without fine-tuning; 1.69–3.66× quality improvement over baselines.
items.unproven: Evaluated on four-domain benchmark only; no measurement of actual PII leakage risk or adversarial attempts to extract masked information; generalization beyond the tested domains unknown.

items.title: Regime-Conditional Verification: Correctness Estimation for Adapting and Monitoring Safety Classifiers
items.dek: Wrapper adapts off-the-shelf LLM safety classifiers without retraining, catching 0.81 of missed unsafe content across three classifiers.
items.unproven: Evaluation limited to two benchmark datasets and held-out harm categories; no evidence deployment detects novel attack strategies beyond the ten campaign types tested; unclear how correctness estimates generalize to real-world policy drift.

items.title: Vectorized SQIsign Implementation Using AVX-512
items.dek: AVX-512 vectorization of SQIsign achieves 2.69× signing speedup; NIST post-quantum standardization candidate.
items.unproven: Speedup measured on reference implementation only; no comparison against other post-quantum signature schemes or real deployment contexts; optimization bound to AVX-512 availability and Intel hardware.

items.title: Universal aspects of bulk density of states in non-Hermitian lattices
items.dek: Non-Hermitian lattice systems exhibit universal bulk density-of-states structure independent of boundary conditions.
items.unproven: experimental validation; applicability to finite-range interactions beyond tight-binding models.

items.title: Measurement-Feedback Quantum Information Engine: Coherence-Transition Interference and Correlated Work Statistics
items.dek: Measurement-feedback quantum engines show coherence-transition interference in work statistics linked to information entropy rate.
items.unproven: experimental realization; scalability to multi-qubit systems; practical extraction of work statistics from noisy hardware.

items.title: Current fluctuations in a non-additive open quantum system: breakdown of the quantum-jump approach
items.dek: Quantum-jump formalism fails for non-additive open systems under perfect detection but recovers under imperfect detection.
items.unproven: experimental tests of detection-quality regimes; applicability beyond the specific non-additive scenarios analyzed.

items.title: Angular displacement readout of a mechanical oscillator with a guided mode resonance
items.dek: Guided-mode-resonance structures achieve shot-noise-limited angular-displacement readout of nanomechanical oscillators at nanowatt power.
items.unproven: scaling to quantum-limited regimes; integration into practical quantum sensors; long-term phase stability.

items.title: Linearised quantum signal processing
items.dek: Linearized quantum signal processing connects universal Hamiltonian eigenvalue transformation to generalized QSP frameworks.
items.unproven: experimental implementation; practical overhead of linearization compared to standard QSVT; applicability to fault-tolerant quantum computers.

items.title: A Hybrid LLM-Based Framework for Automated Security Annotation Generation in Business Process Models
items.dek: LLM pipeline generates SecBPMN2 annotations from process models and security docs; achieves 0.58 precision on 27-model dataset.
items.unproven: small curated dataset; no evidence this scales to real enterprise process repositories; manual annotation remains ground truth.

items.title: Native multi-qubit gates on a single-junction unimon circuit
items.dek: Single-junction multiunimon circuit achieves 99.5% simulated fidelity for multi-qubit gates with simple pulse control.
items.unproven: experimental demonstration; noise improvements needed for 99.99% fidelity; scalability beyond three qubits; near-term device realization.

items.title: Orbital Hall Effect in Weyl Semimetals from quantum geometric band interference
items.dek: Band geometry governs orbital angular momentum transport in TaAs-family Weyl semimetals, validated by ab initio and analytic models.
items.unproven: experimental measurement of orbital Hall effect in these materials; generalization beyond Weyl semimetals; temperature and disorder dependence.

items.title: A Four-Axis Trustworthiness Benchmark for LLM-as-Judge in Principle-Based Regulation
items.dek: LLM-as-judge benchmark on 168 FCA financial-promotion scenarios shows 47-point accuracy drop under keyword-stuffing adversarial inputs.
items.unproven: dataset limited to crypto-asset regulation; no evidence of generalization to other principle-based standards; outside application security scope.

items.title: Structural Leakage in Graph Encryption: Attacks and Defenses
items.dek: Fragment Tree attack recovers 10.24% of shortest-path queries in graph encryption; BlindGES reduces one-to-one token mappings below 20%.
items.unproven: Attacks demonstrated on synthetic and real-world graphs; no evidence of practical feasibility against deployed graph encryption systems; BlindGES evaluated on benchmarks only, not in production.

items.title: Going Dark, and the era of law enforcement hacking
items.dek: Essay on law enforcement encryption workarounds and device access; rehashes known debates without new technical findings.
items.unproven: entirely outside reader's remit; concerns policy and law enforcement capability, not application security engineering or SDLC

items.title: GPU implementation of mixed quantum-classical Liouville molecular dynamics without momentum jump
items.dek: GPU implementation of quantum-classical molecular dynamics achieves tenfold speedup by eliminating thread-divergence overhead.
items.unproven: generalization beyond the specific spawning-free trajectory method tested; production applicability to systems beyond those studied.

noise.title: Google is making private AI practical with homomorphic encryption
noise.dek: Google applies homomorphic encryption to inference; practical deployment timeline and performance overhead remain undisclosed.
noise.unproven: production viability, latency and cost at scale, whether constraints apply to the reader's AI agent use cases in SDLC

noise.title: Europe's scorched landscapes seen from space after summer heatwaves
noise.dek: Satellite imagery of European heat damage; climate reporting outside security scope.
